name: Bleeding
description: The target is bleeding, taking damage. Status can be remedied only by medical attention, magical healing, or special status removal items.

name: Blinded
description: The target is blinded, unable to see and suffering penalties to accuracy and perception. All attacks against them have advantage. Unless specified otherwise, the status has a set duration.

name: Confused
description: The target is confused, unable to act rationally or follow commands. The target can move but can't perform actions.

name: Crippled
description: The target is crippled, reducing their movement speed and agility. The target can act but is unable to move.

name: Distracted
description: The target is distracted and is unable to maintain concentration.

name: Incapacitated
description: The target is incapacitated, unable to move or take any actions other than attempts to remove that status effect.

name: Stunned
description: The target is stunned, unable to take actions, react, or move until the effect ends. The status cannot be removed manually until the effect ends.

name: Prone
description: The target is prone, making them easier to hit with melee attacks but harder to attack with ranged weapon. The status can be removed by spending a movement action.
